thought.text: Dev server runs on port 9001. Let me start it and probe it properly.

reasoning_content: Dev server on port 9001, not 5173. Let me curl 9001. But server may have been killed after timeout 90. Let me start again and probe properly.

action.command: cd /workspace && nohup npm start >/tmp/vite.log 2>&1 & sleep 40; tail -8 /tmp/vite.log; echo "---probe---"; for p in / /index.html /portal/basic/index.html; do printf "%s -> " "$p"; curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "https://localhost:9001$p"; done
